subject.title: feat(providers): add local Lume macOS leases

question: Should Crabbox support Lume as a built-in local macOS SSH-lease provider, including its privileged golden-image preparation contract, rather than leaving this integration external?
rationale: The patch introduces a permanent provider surface and a root-level guest-image setup contract. Source review alone cannot determine whether that product and support boundary belongs in the built-in provider set.

options.title: Sponsor built-in Lume support
options.body: Accept the local Apple-silicon Lume provider direction after the changelog cleanup and review of redacted real-host lifecycle proof.

options.title: Keep the integration external
options.body: Decline the built-in provider boundary if the maintenance and privileged guest-image contract are not desired.

recommendation.title: Sponsor built-in Lume support
recommendation.body: Accept the local Apple-silicon Lume provider direction after the changelog cleanup and review of redacted real-host lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied branch history shows steipete as the most recent and extensive contributor to the Lume lifecycle implementation.
